description: Propose a HEAL plan for the structural defects `detect_defects` finds — circular dependencies, SPOFs, duplicates, disconnected communities — as a list of repairs with what each would change. NEVER MUTATES: `apply_heal` applies the ones you accept, and a project in `rigid` mode makes even that stop at a proposal. Some repairs DELETE nodes, so read each before applying; the check-health skill is the workflow. A merge's `survivor` recommends a `keep_id` only when a real difference separates the two; otherwise `survivor.needs_choice` is true and a person must pick. Ask for this when you want suggested repairs for the design's structural problems, to review before anything changes.

max_operations.description: Cap on structural operations; extras surface in `skipped_operations`.

name: propose_heal
title: Propose a Heal
